ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels, with dark pixels occupying approximately 92% of the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity base (RGB ~20,20,20) overlaid with a stochastic distribution of high-intensity (RGB ~240,240,240) circular point-clusters and thin linear filaments across both lobes, with higher cluster density along the leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 74 degrees and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the medial trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude irregular protrusions at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve fitting the leading edges of both lobes, sweeping upward and outward to jagged distal terminations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular high-contrast pixel clusters (diameters of 3-12 pixels) distributed across the ventral surface, with heavy aggregation along the periphery of the trailing edge and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions, including a prominent diagonal mark on the right lobe distal region and several fine horizontal filaments near the medial notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular topography and apparent tissue loss at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive white scarring across the primary dark-pigmented fluke body.
